context: #1739 district reception and topic replies after the road cutscene, spoken by a named district face.
intent: Welcome the chairman and start discussion of the business already selected on the district sheet.
keep: Keep each speaker’s register and the marked plan position. No decision, allocation, bargain or appointment is promised by a line.
strings: Karasev offers the chairman a seat after the road cutscene for a voluntary trip ends.
Садитесь, товарищ председатель. Папку можно на стол. С чего начнём?
Have a seat, Comrade Chairman. You can put your folder on the desk. Where shall we start?
Karasev asks which construction job needs materials when the chairman brings up the available allocation topic.
Под какую стройку просите? Слово «срочно» у нас уже можно печатать прямо на бланке.
Which job needs the materials? We may as well have “urgent” printed on the form by now.
Karasev asks to see the marked plan position when the chairman has selected an available plan discussion.
Покажите отмеченную строку плана. Начнём с неё.
Show me the line you marked on the plan. We'll start there.
At a confirmed personal appointment for an available plan discussion, Korenev asks why the chairman marked this position.
Вы отметили эту строку. Почему именно её?
You marked this line. Why that one?
